# tier 1, group bg30, route tour, version payload 1.3, role ab
# The automatic behaviour of the owner's 14:04 decision as one switch set (default off until the owner has judged it on the console): even 30 until the pair controller (MSC_PAIR_RATE=1, np_pair_rate.h) is shown the pair fits (game thread and GPU, 1.5 s), then a FULL picture and a LIGHT picture per 33 ms, every picture one refresh; BALANCE=3 moves the crowd pose update and the stadium animation update into the light picture's slot; a camera cut or a pan over 12 px a picture (MSC_BG30_PANPX) makes the picture full. Read: [pair] lines (cadence on/off, why), [bg30g] (kinds, fast pans, balance counters, game ms by kind), [gsplit-bg30] (work phases by kind), [bg30] (renderer), [lane]/[fps] against d1 and bg30half, [pace] late pictures, [lat] p50/p95, [speed] 98 % rule, [hitch]. By eye: player motion smoothness first, then edge smear at the screen edge on a fast pan, crowd and stadium animation, goal posts over players. A crash, a black background or a [pair] flap every few seconds is a failure.
